title: Movement modes
doc: How player input moves and turns the player in each built-in movement mode.

sections.name: #movement modes
sections.doc: One entry per built-in movement mode; each starts at $name: and the list ends at #end.

fields.name: $name:
fields.doc: Built-in movement mode this entry configures; an entry with an unknown name is read and then ignored.

fields.name: $move x ref:
fields.doc: Frame for sideways movement. An unknown name silently counts as none.

fields.name: $move y ref:
fields.doc: Frame for vertical movement. An unknown name silently counts as none.

fields.name: $move z ref:
fields.doc: Frame for forward movement. An unknown name silently counts as none.

fields.name: $rot x ref:
fields.doc: Frame for pitch. An unknown name silently counts as none.

fields.name: $rot y ref:
fields.doc: Frame for heading. An unknown name silently counts as none.

fields.name: $rot z ref:
fields.doc: Frame for roll. An unknown name silently counts as none.
